releases.notes:
### Changed

- Build: mod version 2.2.0.

### Fixed

- HUD: corrected all deferred (post-task) draw positions after Meteor 26.2's
  `HudRenderer` pose change — `begin()` now pushes a `1/guiScale` pose and post
  tasks run inside it, so posted draws expect full GUI-pixel coordinates.
  ArmorHud+ armor icons, TargetHud player heads (Blackout and ExhibitionOld
  modes), and GearHud items drew detached toward the top-left because they
  carried 1.21.11-era `/2` coordinate compensation that had only ever been
  correct at guiScale 2. GearHud items are now deferred through `renderer.post`
  per the 26.2 contract (they were drawn synchronously with a stale
  compensation hack), and ArmorHudPlus's dead `PoseStack` usage is dropped.
  Verified in-game on MC 26.2 / Meteor 26.2-SNAPSHOT. (`4ea4516`)

releases.notes:
Update for Minecraft 26.2 and Meteor Client 26.2.

**Toolchain** — Baritone 26.2-SNAPSHOT, Fabric Loader 0.19.3, Fabric Loom 1.17-SNAPSHOT, Gradle 9.6.1. fabric.mod.json declares ~26.2 compatibility and meteor-client >=26.2-0 (matches Meteor's distributed 26.2-N pre-release versioning).

**Ported to the 26.2 APIs**
- 62 BlockPos.getCenter() call sites (22 files) → static Vec3.atCenterOf
- EntityType constants → the new EntityTypes class (AutoTrapPlus, SelfTrapPlus)
- Items.RED_BED removal → instanceof BedItem / Items.BED.pick(DyeColor.RED) (OffHandPlus)
- Minecraft.screen field removal → mc.gui.screen(); Gui.getChat() → mc.gui.hud.getChat()
- ClientboundSetPlayerTeamPacket.Parameters record accessors (PacketNames)

**Mixins** — MixinItemInHandRenderer retargeted to the renamed ItemInHandRenderer.submitHandsWithItems/submitArmWithItem; all 12 mixins and both access-widener entries revalidated against 26.2 mojmap.

**Verified** — boots and loads cleanly in a 26.2 instance alongside meteor-client 26.2-4 and Baritone 26.2-SNAPSHOT.

Full changelog: https://github.com/MCDxAI/blackout-addon-updated/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

releases.notes:
First public release of the BlackOut port — retargeted from Minecraft 1.21.11 to **Meteor Client 26.1.x / Minecraft 26.1.2**, with the full source converted to mojmap and revalidated against 26.1.2.

**Requires:** Minecraft 26.1.x · Meteor Client 26.1.x · Fabric Loader 0.19.2+ · Java 25+

### Added
- Docs: `CHANGELOG.md` (Keep a Changelog) backfilled with the 26.1.x port work.
- Project automation: `.pi/` config — agents, skills, the `minecraft-dev` MCP server, and the bootstrap manifest.
- Tooling: autonomous in-game test-client verification harness + Meteor MCP wiring.

### Changed
- Build: wired Spotless + Google Java Format; normalized the source tree (2-space indent, no wildcard imports, K&R braces, 100-column limit).
- RaytraceSettings: renamed the `ClipContext` field → `clipContext` (it shadowed its own type); updated 19 access sites.
- RaytraceSettings: consolidated onto Meteor's built-in `IClipContext`, dropping BlackOut's duplicate.
- Housekeeping: expanded a wildcard settings import to explicit imports and corrected the mappings note.

### Removed
- Cleanup: stale IDE-remapper junk comments in 7 modules.
- `blackout.accesswidener`: removed the unused `Holder$Reference bindKey` entry.
- Cleanup: 7 vestigial accessor mixins with zero call sites (latent startup-crash risk under `defaultRequire: 1`).

### Fixed
- Build: locked the mojmap environment and corrected `fabric.mod.json` dependency declarations.
- Port: converted 15 source files from mixed yarn/mojmap to consistent mojmap.
- Port: fixed all remaining Minecraft + Meteor 26.1.2 API breaks.
- Port: revalidated every mixin and the access widener against Minecraft 26.1.2.
- Port: fixed four runtime mixin-resolution failures found via `runClient` smoke tests.
- Port: retargeted `MixinPlayer` `SoundModifier.crystalHits` to the 26.1.2 server-side sound path.
- Tooling: PowerShell 5.1 encoding fix in the launcher + Baritone at `runClient` runtime.
- AutoCart: repaired **Auto Ignite** — it was a no-op that interacted with the floor instead of the TNT-minecart entity; removed the dead `placeMode` setting and added a configurable `placementLimit`.
- BOEntityUtils: **restored the section-scoped, allocation-free, first-hit entity-intersection fast path** that was lost during porting (a genuine AutoCrystal/HoleFill accuracy regression).

Full details in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/MCDxAI/blackout-addon-updated/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
